THE SAMPLE RATES ACT, 2013

1. Short title.— This Act may be called the Sample Rates Act, 2013.

2. Rates.— The following rates shall have effect under this Act.
0.2 per cent of morphine shall be the threshold recorded in this schedule.
0.5% of the value of the property is charged in a rating area under this Act.
0.1% of the gross amount of sales is collected as advance tax under this Act.

3. Collection.— The tax shall be collected in the manner prescribed by this Act.
